newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Malbak says in talks.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Malbak says in talks.

text.p: Recently-unbundled South African firm Malbak Ltd said on Thursday that it is in talks which may have an effect on its share price.
"Shareholders are accordingly advised to exercise caution when dealing in their Malbak shares until a further announcement is made," the firm said in a statement.
Earlier this week Malbak Ltd rose strongly, buoyed by market talk that conglomerate Rembrandt (Remgro) was set to buy a stake in it.
Share traders said Malbak, now focused in the packaging sector since its restructure, also looked to be on the road to posting strong results.
South Africa's Business Times newspaper reported on Sunday that it was "common knowledge in the market" that Remgro was keen to buy Malbak and merge their packaging interests.
Remgro's packaging operations are held largely through a 30 percent stake in Printpak and a 17 percent stake in Lenco, the paper said.
Malbak's primary assets since the unbundling are a 68 percent stake in Kohler Ltd and a 64 percent interest in U.K-listed MY Holdings Plc.
